items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: You made that record with Ike Quebec.

ctx.x: No. Sometimes you get louder horns. That might be possible but I think it mostly was that Basie always wanted me to play like Joe Smith which was in a...... But I had changed playing all the way, I didn't play that way in California, the way I played with Basie. You know, like the mute is still on going to Chicago, many, cup mutes all the time. I played so many cup mutes I wrote a song called "Cup Mute Clayton". Do you remember that?
You made that record with Ike Quebec.
Ike Quebec, yes, "Cup Mute Clayton". (LAUGHTER). I didn't mind playing the cup mute sometimes, but, ......
